summary: Scans and parses TypeScript source files within a codebase using pattern-based file discovery and syntax tree generation. It leverages fast-glob for file retrieval and Tree-sitter to construct Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) for static code analysis.
capabilities: Fast pattern-based file matching across source directories using fast-glob
AST generation for TypeScript files via Tree-sitter
File system access and path resolution for source code inspection
